title: FAANG Fuels Midweek Market 'Melt-Up'
text:
FAANG Fuels Midweek Market 'Melt-Up' By 0
The word of the day is 'melt-up.' There wasn't any particular reason for stocks to rise Wednesday but the overbought indices sprinted higher and all the major indices, except for the Dow Jones Industrial Average hit new all-time highs. Breadth went from about even early in the day to nearly 2 to 1 positive by the market close and the number of new 12-month highs expanded to 520.
The stars of the show Wednesday were the big-cap technology stocks and the FAANG names in particular. Amazon (AMZN) received a very well-timed price target increase from Morgan Stanley to $2,500 from $1,850 and that helped the group. The mighty Apple (AAPL) did some very heavy lifting as well with a gain of 1.5% and a move to a new all-time high....213
